levels.name: Level 1
levels.subtitle: Short Vowels + CVC
levels.description: Continuous consonants, short vowels, and CVC word blending

modules.name: Sound Drill
modules.instructions: Listen to each sound and repeat it. Tap the speaker to hear again.

modules.name: Tap the Sounds
modules.description: Tap each box to hear phonemes in a word
modules.instructions: Tap each sound box to hear the phoneme. Then tap the word box to blend.

modules.name: Build the Word
modules.description: Drag grapheme tiles to build words
modules.instructions: Listen to the word. Drag the letters into the boxes to build it.

modules.name: Blend and Read
modules.description: Practice blending phonemes into full words
modules.instructions: Move the slider to control blending speed. Slide slowly to blend the sounds.

modules.name: Minimal Pairs
modules.instructions: Listen to the two words. Select the word you hear.

levels.name: Level 2
levels.subtitle: Digraphs + Blends
levels.description: Consonant digraphs, final blends, and initial blends

modules.name: Sound Drill
modules.instructions: Listen to each sound. These sounds use two letters!

modules.name: Tap the Sounds
modules.description: Tap each box to hear phonemes in a word
modules.instructions: Some boxes have two letters but one sound. Tap to hear each phoneme.

modules.name: Build the Word
modules.description: Build words with digraphs and blends
modules.instructions: Listen to the word. Drag the letter tiles (some have two letters).

modules.name: Blend and Read
modules.instructions: Blend these longer words using the slider.

modules.name: Minimal Pairs
modules.description: Ship vs. chip — can you hear the difference?
modules.instructions: Listen carefully to /sh/ vs /ch/ and other close sounds.

levels.name: Level 3
levels.subtitle: Silent E + Long Vowels
levels.description: Magic-e patterns and long vowel sounds

modules.name: Sound Drill
modules.description: Hear long vowels vs. short vowels
modules.instructions: Notice how the silent 'e' changes the vowel sound!

modules.name: Tap the Sounds
modules.description: Hear long vowel sounds in magic-e words
modules.instructions: The silent e doesn't have its own box — it changes the vowel!

modules.name: Build the Word
modules.instructions: Don't forget the silent e at the end!

modules.name: Minimal Pairs
modules.description: Short vs. long vowels: hat/hate, pin/pine
modules.instructions: Can you hear the difference? Short vowel vs. long vowel.

levels.name: Level 4
levels.subtitle: Vowel Teams + R-Controlled
levels.description: Vowel teams and r-controlled vowel patterns

modules.name: Sound Drill
modules.instructions: Two vowels working together make one sound.

modules.name: Tap the Sounds
modules.instructions: Two vowel letters = one phoneme box.
